Ramayana Film Nears ₹900 Crore Worldwide Box Office

The film "Ramayana," starring Ranbir Kapoor, Sai Pallavi, and Yash, has achieved a worldwide box office collection nearing ₹900 crore by its sixth day. On Day 6, the film reportedly earned ₹94.10 crore net in India, with the Hindi version contributing ₹76 crore and other language versions accounting for the remainder. The film's worldwide collection reached approximately ₹823 crore by Day 6. Separately, a film titled "Scene," featuring Suriya, was reported to have earned ₹150 crore worldwide by its fourth day, with its Tamil version leading.
